verdict.rationale: Fern is a docs and SDK platform with AI features (Ask Fern, Fern Agent), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack has no documented control or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Password protection, visitor authentication and agent directives are related access controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
